_note: ai-features-on-the-case-consume-hermiq task 4.1 (REQ-AIC-04, design D-4). The group hermiq placed a new case in, kept on the case so the case is placed exactly once: hermiq's evaluation adds the report to a group, so asking again would count the same resident twice. Only the id is kept; the count, members and near-duplicates are read from hermiq when the case is opened, because they change as more reports arrive. Written by ReportGroupingConsumer::placeCase() from ReportGroupingJob, and only for a case type that declares the report-similarity feature. A fragment rather than an edit to dossiq_register.json, per ADR-037.

reportGroupId.title: Report group
reportGroupId.description: The group of similar reports this case was placed in by hermiq, when its case type groups reports. Grouping does not change the confirmations of receipt: every report still gets its own.
